svg.text: Declared as Terraform in infra/ and applied to ap-south-1. One stage variable selects the build: stage 1 a single EC2 instance, stage 2 RDS Multi-AZ, stage 3 the diagram above.
Both instances write to the RDS primary endpoint; the standby takes over on failover. Shell access is SSM Session Manager, so the VPC has no SSH ingress.
